cases.title: Независимая функция
cases.proof: The switch accepts a persistent independent setting without a separate confirmation.

cases.title: Состав операции
cases.proof: Checkboxes select independent conditions without implying a running source.

cases.title: Один режим из группы
cases.proof: Native radio selection replaces the previous value and retains its selection on repeated clicks.

cases.title: Смешанное состояние родителя
cases.proof: The parent reflects the children. Individual checkboxes reflect only their own item.

cases.title: Недоступные состояния
cases.proof: Disabled controls retain their value and ignore pointer/keyboard activation.

cases.title: Ожидание, ошибка и повтор
cases.proof: Reject duplicate activation, preserve accepted state on failure, and preserve focus through recovery.

cases.title: Модификации плотности
cases.proof: One component owns each control across the trial 16/18/20 px drawing sizes.

cases.title: Многострочная подпись
cases.proof: The circle stays aligned with the first label line, independently of description height.

cases.title: Настройка с тестовым потоком
cases.proof: Persistent settings remain distinct from future-operation inclusion and retain their accepted state after rejected live-test application.

cases.title: Нейтральные фильтры библиотеки
cases.proof: A scoped proposed filter tone uses theme-inverted selection without orange and retains stable layout when its label becomes semibold.
